name: Cheesy Marinara Chicken & Pepper Pitas with Italian Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a large bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice peppers lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and continue to cook until peppers are soft and sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes more.
Add peppers and sauce to the bowl with the chicken and stir to combine. Transfer to a large baking dish and sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven and broil until the cheese is melted, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Place greens in another large bowl along with carrots and dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup Italian salad dressing

instructions.primary_message: Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets; stuff each pocket with chicken and peppers.
To serve, divide pitas and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
